Cleaning up implementation in https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/pull/51414/ while addressing some of the limitations rightfully pointed out re: block allocation tracking.
To recap, this PR only covers the interface changes required to allow connectors to initialize asynchronously (`is_ready` behaviour), so that the various implementations we support can opt in with ad-hoc methods.

One of the differences wrt original PR is how connectors can opt-in ie
```
class MyAsyncConnector(SupportsAsyncInit):  # instead of KVConnectorBase_V1
    def __init__(self, vllm_config, role, kv_cache_config):
        super().__init__(vllm_config, role, kv_cache_config)
        if role == KVConnectorRole.WORKER:
            # Connector-specific: start slow setup however suits the connector (Future here).
            self._init = ThreadPoolExecutor(1).submit(self._allocate_host_buffers)

    def is_init_done(self) -> bool:
        # Polled on workers each step until True; raising here (or exceeding
        # VLLM_KV_CONNECTOR_INIT_TIMEOUT) fails the engine.
        if self._init.done():
            self._init.result() 
        return self._init.done()
```

A connector that is either ready or does not initialize asynchronously should have zero-overhead from the scaffolding added here.

```
    def __init__(self, vllm_config, role, kv_cache_config):
        super().__init__(vllm_config, role, kv_cache_config)
        if role == KVConnectorRole.WORKER:
            # Connector-specific: start slow setup however suits the connector (Future here).
            self._init = ThreadPoolExecutor(1).submit(self._allocate_host_buffers)

    def is_init_done(self) -> bool:
        # Polled on workers each step until True; raising here (or exceeding
        # VLLM_KV_CONNECTOR_INIT_TIMEOUT) fails the engine.
        if self._init.done():
            self._init.result() 
        return self._init.done()
```

A connector that is either ready or does not initialize asynchronously should have zero-overhead from the scaffolding added here.

 ## Third-party contributions
 
+### Asynchronous connector initialization
+
+`KVConnectorBase_V1` connectors are ready by default. A connector that permits
+GPU-only serving during initialization can inherit `SupportsAsyncInit` instead
+(Model Runner V2 only) and implement `is_init_done()`. The hook reports whether
+the current worker's setup has finished; how that setup runs is up to the
+connector. Raise any initialization error from that hook; errors terminate the
+engine.
+
+Readiness is latched: this interface supports startup, not runtime disable or
+reconfiguration. The scheduler activates a connector only after every worker has
+reported ready. Workers continue reporting until the scheduler acknowledges
+readiness by sending real connector metadata. Reports travel with ordinary engine
+steps; initialization alone does not keep an idle engine stepping. After an idle
+period, requests admitted before the scheduler observes readiness are served
+without that connector for their whole lifetime, even if workers have already
+finished initializing. Initialization errors are also observed when stepping
+resumes. Workers raise if setup is not done within
+`VLLM_KV_CONNECTOR_INIT_TIMEOUT` seconds (default 1800), checked on engine steps.
+
+Requests admitted before readiness remain excluded for their whole lifetime,
+including chunked prefill, preemption and completion notifications. With
+`MultiConnector`, eligibility is tracked separately for each child, so ready
+children can serve while others initialize. Only opt into asynchronous startup
+when skipping the connector is valid; a required P/D transfer cannot be skipped.
+
+Scheduler-side callers route request hooks through a handler resolved once per
+connector with `get_request_handler()`, which owns exclusions, metadata filtering
+and completion cleanup. Connector implementations keep their existing hooks;
+`MultiConnector` uses each child's handler to apply the same rules independently.
+
+Request exclusion does not hide physical block reuse. The scheduler-local
+`SchedulerOutput.kv_connector_block_state.allocated_block_ids` includes allocations
+for **all** requests, including asynchronous loads. Allocations are recorded by
+the block pool and drained once per scheduler step. Connectors with pending
+transfers must use these IDs, together with copy-on-write destinations in
+`kv_cache_block_copies`, to fence transfers before GPU memory is overwritten.
+These allocation notifications remain available even when the connector's request
+view is empty.
+
+Initialization does not suppress lifecycle hooks. Metadata reporting, worker
+output updates, statistics, cache reset and shutdown must be safe while the
+connector is initializing. Request transfer hooks are skipped until the
+scheduler sends real metadata. Background allocation or other initialization
+work remains the connector's responsibility.
+
+Async initialization requires Model Runner V2. `SupportsAsyncInit` raises during
+construction if Model Runner V1 is selected, including automatic fallback to V1.
+It also currently rejects multi-rank `external_launcher` and Ray pipeline
+parallelism due to limitations in collecting readiness from every worker in those
+output paths. Synchronous connectors remain supported on Model Runner V1.
+

+class SupportsAsyncInit(KVConnectorBase_V1):
+    """Connectors that initialize asynchronously with Model Runner V2.
+
+    Inherit this instead of KVConnectorBase_V1 and implement is_init_done(),
+    which reports the current worker's setup; how it runs is up to the connector.
+    Serving must work without this connector so vllm can hide its startup
+    latency. Readiness is monotonic; activation waits for all workers' reports
+    during ordinary engine steps. Idle engines do not poll. Metadata reporting,
+    output updates, stats, reset and shutdown must remain safe while
+    initializing. Requests admitted before readiness are never shown to this
+    connector, except as finished request IDs on the worker, which must be
+    ignored. Callers reach these hooks through get_request_handler(), so other
+    connectors carry no readiness API.
+    """
+
+    # Class-level so instances built without __init__ default to synchronous.
+    _async_init_enabled = False
+    _connector_ready = True
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        vllm_config: "VllmConfig",
+        role: KVConnectorRole,
+        kv_cache_config: "KVCacheConfig",

+        super().__init__(vllm_config, role, kv_cache_config)
+        self.enable_async_init()
+
+    def enable_async_init(self) -> None:
+        """Validate the deployment and start waiting for worker readiness."""
+        if not self._vllm_config.use_v2_model_runner:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Asynchronous connector initialization requires Model Runner V2"
+            )
+        parallel_config = self._vllm_config.parallel_config
+        backend = parallel_config.distributed_executor_backend
+        if (backend == "external_launcher" and parallel_config.world_size > 1) or (

+        ):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "Asynchronous connector initialization requires readiness reports "
+                "from every worker; external_launcher with multiple ranks and "
+                "Ray pipeline parallelism are not supported"
+            )
+        self._async_init_enabled = True
+        self._connector_ready = False
+        self._ready_connector_ranks: set[int] = set()
+        self._init_start_time = time.monotonic()
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def is_init_done(self) -> bool:
+        """Whether the current worker's setup has finished; raise on failure.
+
+        Polled on workers only, once per engine step until it returns True.
+        Raises TimeoutError if still False after VLLM_KV_CONNECTOR_INIT_TIMEOUT.
+        """
+        raise NotImplementedError
+
+    def is_connector_ready(self) -> bool:
+        """Whether this connector can accept new requests.
+
+        Workers latch their own is_init_done(); the scheduler waits for every
+        worker's report.
+        """
+        if not self._async_init_enabled:
+            return True
+        if self._role == KVConnectorRole.WORKER and not self._connector_ready:
+            self._connector_ready = self.is_init_done()
+            elapsed = time.monotonic() - self._init_start_time
+            if not self._connector_ready and (

+            ):
+                raise TimeoutError(

+                    f"within {envs.VLLM_KV_CONNECTOR_INIT_TIMEOUT}s"
+                )

+
+    def requires_allocation_tracking(self) -> bool:
+        """Whether initialization can hide block reuse."""
+        return not self.is_connector_ready()

+    def build_connector_init_status(self) -> KVConnectorInitStatus | None:
+        """Report initialization until this step has real connector metadata."""
+        if (
+            not self._async_init_enabled
+            or self._role != KVConnectorRole.WORKER
+            or self.has_connector_metadata()

+            ready_ranks={rank} if self.is_connector_ready() else set(),

+    Requests admitted before readiness stay excluded through completion.
+    Callers must check is_eligible() before invoking per-request hooks.
+    """

+
+    def is_connector_ready(self) -> bool:
+        return self._connector.is_connector_ready()
+
+    def is_eligible(self, request_id: str) -> bool:
+        return request_id not in self._excluded_request_ids
+
+    def requires_allocation_tracking(self) -> bool:
+        return (
+            bool(self._excluded_request_ids)
+            or self._connector.requires_allocation_tracking()
+        )
+
+    def on_new_request(self, request: "Request") -> None:
+        if self._connector.is_connector_ready():
+            self._connector.on_new_request(request)
+        else:
+            self._excluded_request_ids.add(request.request_id)

+    def build_connector_meta(
+        self, scheduler_output: SchedulerOutput
+    ) -> KVConnectorMetadata:
+        if self._connector.is_connector_ready():
+            metadata = self._connector.build_connector_meta(
+                scheduler_output.without_requests(self._excluded_request_ids)

+        return metadata
+
+    def build_connector_init_status(self) -> KVConnectorInitStatus | None:
+        return self._connector.build_connector_init_status()
+
+    def update_connector_init_status(
+        self, status: KVConnectorInitStatus | None
+    ) -> None:
+        self._connector.update_connector_init_status(status)
+

+def get_request_handler(connector: KVConnectorBase_V1) -> KVConnectorRequestHandler:
+    if isinstance(connector, SupportsAsyncInit):

+    return KVConnectorRequestHandler(connector)
